# peakhour_rp_lua_options (Resource)

Manages RP Lua options for a domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "peakhour_rp_lua_options" "example" {
  domain      = "example.com"
  lua_enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain name.

### Optional

- `lua_enabled` (Boolean) Whether Lua processing is enabled. Set to null to clear.
- `lua_origin_pool_selector` (String) Lua origin pool selector. Set to null to clear.
- `lua_origin_request_filter` (String) Lua origin request filter. Set to null to clear.
- `lua_origin_response_filter` (String) Lua origin response filter. Set to null to clear.
- `lua_origin_selector` (String) Lua origin selector. Set to null to clear.
- `lua_request_filter` (String) Lua request filter. Set to null to clear.
- `lua_response_filter` (String) Lua response filter. Set to null to clear.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) RP Lua options identifier (domain/rp_lua_options).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import peakhour_rp_lua_options.example example.com
```
